# Vendored references (pinned, read-only)

Selected files from top open-source agentic-dev projects. They are **references** that Orkestra's
playbooks were distilled from — none of them is loaded automatically, so they never hijack the workflow.
Each folder keeps its upstream LICENSE (copyright lines and notes: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`). Refresh with `install.sh --refresh-vendor`.

| folder | upstream | commit | date | license | used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| superpowers | https://github.com/obra/superpowers | 8ca22db | 2026-09-25 | MIT | subagent loop, TDD + verification discipline, debugging |
| spec-kit | https://github.com/github/spec-kit | ae5ade7 | 2026-10-03 | MIT | spec/plan/tasks templates, clarify taxonomy |
| bmad | https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD | 3cae711 | 2026-10-03 | MIT (+trademark) | frozen plan, review prompts & triage |
| gsd-core | https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core | c1df571 | 2026-10-03 | MIT | machine-checked TDD, goal-backward verification, context budget |
| openspec | https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec | 2500d6d | 2026-10-02 | MIT | living specs (source of truth per capability) |
| humanlayer | https://github.com/humanlayer/humanlayer | 99abe67 | 2026-06-18 | Apache-2.0 | documentarian codebase locator/analyzer agents |
| compound | https://github.com/EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin | 9af474a | 2026-10-01 | MIT | learnings capture bar |
| ecc | https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC | ef648e0 | 2026-10-01 | MIT | security / stack / data / ui-flow review checklists |
| karpathy | https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills | 2c60614 | 2026-04-20 | MIT (declared; no upstream LICENSE file) | surgical diff, simplicity, surfaced assumptions |
